ambient_definitions.literal_definition: def equivPermutationMatrix {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (equiv : ι ≃ ι) : Matrix ι ι ℂ := fun row column => if row = equiv column then 1 else 0

ambient_definitions.name: Equiv
ambient_definitions.signature: (α : Sort u) → (β : Sort v) → Sort (max (max 1 u) v)
structural_contract: e : α ≃ β has functions e : α → β and e.symm : β → α with e.symm (e x) = x and e (e.symm y) = y.

ambient_definitions.name: Matrix
normalized_equations: Matrix m n α = m → n → α
(A * B) row column = ∑ k, A row k * B k column
(star A) row column = star (A column row)
For complex entries, star z is complex conjugation.
(1 : Matrix ι ι ℂ) row column = if row = column then 1 else 0
ambient_definitions.signature: (m : Type u) → (n : Type v) → (α : Type w) → Type (max u v w)

ambient_definitions.membership: A ∈ Matrix.unitaryGroup ι ℂ ↔ star A * A = 1; for finite complex square matrices this is equivalent to A * star A = 1.
ambient_definitions.name: Matrix.unitaryGroup
ambient_definitions.signature: ∀ (ι : Type u) [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype ι] (α : Type v) [CommRing α] [StarRing α], Submonoid (Matrix ι ι α)

ambient_definitions.name: Matrix.mulVec
normalized_equations: Matrix.mulVec A state row = ∑ column, A row column * state column
ambient_definitions.signature: ∀ {m : Type u} {n : Type v} [Fintype n], Matrix m n ℂ → (n → ℂ) → (m → ℂ)

conventions: All matrices have entries in ℂ and act on column vectors from the left.
For LCUIndex the register order is coefficient × (selector × system).
Type variables range over arbitrary universes as declared in each formal context; Fintype does not impose Nonempty.
No normalized-state, approximation or circuit-cost assertion is implicit.
